sloka: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् ।पुनरप्यहमार्यां तामिदं वचनमब्रुवम् ।। ५.६७.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: vaidehyā vacanaṁ śrutvā karuṇaṁ sāśrubhāṣitam ।punarapyahamāryāṁ tāmidaṁ vacanamabruvam ।। 5.67.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "And when Rama is overcome with sorrow, Lakshmana burns with it. Your ladyship has been found at last; this is no time for grieving.
